title: Scouting and Escalation Log
description: A repeatable scouting record for locations, observations, evidence captured, immediate containment, and escalation status.
instructions: Describe what was observed before assigning a diagnosis.
Record the exact location and evidence captured.
Keep observation, containment, escalation, and authorized disposition as separate fields.
limitations: This log does not authorize pesticide use, crop disposition, or diagnosis beyond the learner's role.
Follow applicable labels, regulations, and approved site procedures.
